content: Currently, long exact sequences of homology are done using ComposableArrows 5, e.g. HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.composableArrows₅ and CategoryTheory.Abelian.extFunctor. Would it make sense for me to add versions of the 4 lemma and 5 lemma for ComposableArrows 5?
ComposableArrows 5 involve six objects, so that this should probably go in a separate Six.lean file.
I figured it made sense to keep it in the same file since the file also has the 5 lemma as well as the 4 lemma applied to short exact sequences. Maybe it makes sense to just call the section Six?
